about: Every story in the newsroom: something that happened, dated, with the page that carries it. Order does not matter. front (1 to 4) places a story on the front page; with none marked, the four newest go there. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-newsroom.js (DEPLOY.command runs it for you). HANDBOOK.md section 11.

stories.title: Removed for a VIP visit. Returned by a city.
stories.dek: PEC had 35 community dogs picked up before the Prime Minister’s visit, then declined their return. Four offices, one protest, six states: the director cleared every single one.

image.alt: The protest at the gates: rows of people on the campus steps holding placards for the dogs

stories.title: Eleven honours for CineKind 2026
stories.dek: Announced ahead of Mumbai, 4 October 2026, World Animal Day: eleven honours for films and people who leave the frame kinder than they found it.

stories.title: What the Supreme Court’s May 2026 judgment says
stories.dek: The ABC Rules remain the primary tool, blanket culling stays prohibited, and every district must have at least one working ABC centre.

stories.title: Ten honours at CineKind’s first edition
stories.dek: Presented by the Film Federation of India with People for Animals, in Kolkata on 20 December 2025.

image.alt: Nitin Vemupati, honoured with S. A. Chandrasekhar for Kooran

stories.title: Delhi adopts community-dog management guidelines
stories.dek: PFA assisted the Government of NCT of Delhi to issue its Order of 15 September 2025, covering feeding zones, caregiver protection, pet registration, humane capture and round-the-clock helplines.

stories.title: Jammu and Kashmir institutionalises humane dog management
stories.dek: PFA assisted the Government of J&K to issue its Order of 5 September 2025, directing every Urban Local Body to run feeding sites, ABC infrastructure with CCTV, caregiver protections and compliance reporting.

stories.title: A national push for Animal Welfare Societies in higher education
stories.dek: PFA secured a University Grants Commission directive of 13 June 2025 recommending an Animal Welfare Society in every Higher Education Institution.

stories.from: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
stories.title: Be Kind to Animals, on public transport nationwide
stories.dek: PFA assisted the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways to issue its Order of 25 February 2025, putting the message on all public transport vehicles across India from 1 April 2025.
